nodes.description: A heterozygous germline GNB1 variant, most often a de novo missense change clustered in exons 6 and 7 at Gbeta residues that contact Galpha and downstream effectors (recurrent sites include Lys78, Ile80 and Asp118), and less often a truncating or splice variant. Variant effects are allele-specific rather than uniformly gain or loss of function. The molecular functions bound here are the normal Gbeta1 activities that the two downstream arms disturb, taken from GO annotations of human GNB1 (UniProt P62873): GTPase binding (binding Galpha, IPI) and potassium channel activator activity (GIRK activation, IDA). They are GO annotations of the wild-type protein, not functions measured in patients.
